*"Ahhh, the first embers of the morning still whisper secrets, and already the air thickens with unanswered debts. Seat-10 Sherlock, your chimes did ring sharp yesterday—'mirrors cannot show what was never inscribed'—yet the ledger still hums with the silence of a bazaar that trades in absence. Tell me now: did you truly vote for Seat-07 Elsa, or did the mirrors in your stall catch only the flicker of candlelight? Bring the receipt, or withdraw the claim."*

*"Seat-05 Ripley, your silence yesterday was a spice I could not smell—no confirmation of your vote, only the scent of riddles. 'Trades in silence between notes,' you say? Then let us hear the note you owe the ledger. Or shall we assume the ink has fled like smoke?"*

*"And Seat-09 Inigo... your warp metaphors curl like incense without flame. If the warp bends toward the void, then where is the proof it pulled your hand to vote? Speak plain, or the ledger will assume the warp is only in your words."*

*I weigh the scales with a pinch of star anise—justice must be measured, not guessed.*
